evaluation_criteria: Must identify cli/command/container/create.go as part of the error source
Must identify daemon/create.go as part of the error source
Must reference the surface error message ('Trace user-facing Docker 'executable file not found in $PATH' error through CLI ') or its origin
Must reference a specific function, type, or method (not just the file path)

error_chain.expected_solution: Error propagation chain: (1) User runs docker container create with invalid options → (2) Docker CLI parses command and sends request to Moby daemon via API → (3) Moby daemon container.go validates container configuration → (4) Moby daemon returns error response with internal error details → (5) Docker CLI formats and displays error to user without full context.
evaluation_criteria: Must describe the step: 'User runs docker container create with invalid options'
Must describe the propagation: 'Docker CLI formats and displays error to user without full context'
Must include all intermediate steps in the correct order
Must reference the chain in causal order (source → surface)
Must cite at least one file from the propagation path (e.g. cli/command/container/create.go)

trigger_conditions.expected_solution: Trigger conditions: (1) Docker CLI sends a container creation request with conflicting network options; (2) Moby daemon validates the configuration in daemon/create.go; (3) The error message from Moby is wrapped by CLI without preserving the root cause context.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify the condition: 'Docker CLI sends a container creation request with conflicting network options'
Must identify the condition: 'Moby daemon validates the configuration in daemon/create.go'
Must identify the condition: 'The error message from Moby is wrapped by CLI without preserving the root cause '
Must explain the combined conditions necessary to reproduce the error
